title: Design the timed switch in docs/DESIGN.md
goal: How a timed switch is asked, stored, reverted and cancelled is written before code
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both", including a timed switch in Grover ("spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore") via MCP behind NERV's approval. Italian is required for every model-facing feature.
Shape: grover_switch gains an optional durationMinutes (integer, 1 to 720 by default) rather than a new tool, so one hardware tool keeps one approval; the reply names the revert time

The hub enforces the revert: the timer is stored in the hub's SQLite, survives a hub restart (an overdue revert runs at start), and runs whether or not NERV is online; if the agent is offline at revert time the hub retries and raises an alert (alerts/1) instead of dropping it

Defaults stated for the owner to change: revert to the state before the timed switch, or, for a light that follows the calendar, to what the calendar says at revert time; a later manual switch, stop-all or mode change cancels the timer; pumps keep their bounded runs and never take a duration
Option recorded for later: also hand the deadline to the agent so it reverts if the hub is down
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one design section from commands.ts, lights.ts and alerts.ts. Not a measurement.
